title: Core 11-Woman #09
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, eleven women in a single row.

A photograph of ELEVEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 11 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render. Exactly 11 women, no more, no fewer.

Left to right:
[Jamaican Dancehall Glam / Black Glamour]: Jamaican woman, mid 40s, demure and soft, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a chin-length bob, coffin nails (holographic). a shockingly extreme waist-to-hip contrast — a colossal bust, an extremely narrow cinched waist, hips flaring to many times that width. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Piercings: 15pc bars/opals/mixed metal/asym. Jewellery: seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of platinum a necklace. Pose: back fully to camera. Shoes: extreme cobalt-and-ochre sculptural heels.
[Uzbek Silk Road Glam / Legend Bust]: Uzbek woman, early 20s, demure and soft, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in long thick box braids, coffin nails (glittery). an upper body dominated entirely by one mythologically enormous bust, far wider than her own shoulders, the defining feature. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Piercings: no piercings. Jewellery: four to six pieces, layered of platinum a bracelet. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward. Shoes: extreme mother-of-pearl platform stiletto Mary Janes.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large. Exactly 11 women total.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 11, catching each woman's own painted pattern and piercings distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
